verdict.rationale: RUN documents its own ability to import employees' hours from an existing timesheet file into payroll using AI (adp-run-docs-17), and it claims payroll can connect with time-tracking tools (adp-run-docs-8). That gets hourly entries into the payroll run, but through a file import or a connected tool rather than a documented native time-to-payroll flow, and overtime is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit overtime calculation and flow-through, native or real-time time-entry sync into the payroll run, independent or hands-on corroboration.
